limitations_and_next_gates: This is a configuration component, not complete R35 or real cloud acceptance
Caller must hold the exclusive journal lock
Admin, credential group, encrypted synthetic credentials and a synthetic active release are fixture prerequisites, not proof of the actual private import and release publication implementation
The setup guard is injected by the fixture; concrete expiring setup authority, callback grant validation and revocation still need composition
Source creation/installation, actual callback-to-registration progression and three fresh reports still require whole-application verification
Control DNS/TLS setup must precede source callbacks; edge records must follow source identity
A1 exact cleanup, real cooldown, A2 retry and B isolation still require the complete assembled lifecycle test
The installed node ELF is synthetic and was not executed; final real-node provenance and unarmed runtime freeze remain outstanding
Current historical live approval is not reused; new live authorization and fresh minimal preflight remain required
